description: Merged epam/ketcher pull requests that the review hub is measured on. `head` is the commit the maintainer reviewed, `base` the master commit it branched from. An entry with expected findings measures recall; an entry without them was approved with no comment, so every confirmed finding there is checked for a false positive. `size: "large"` marks a PR with a large diff; an entry without it is small, and the report scores the two sizes apart with --size.

entries.title: #7441 – Allow for modification of the attachment points in the monomer creation wizard
entries.head: 33741bf3f217dd7c5372cf1eec84f31c46093cb1

expected.summary: The reduce callback mutates its accumulator, which hides the data flow; return a new value each iteration or use forEach.
The rest of this render code should move into a function whose name says what it draws.
The event handlers attached here are never removed.
The setTimeout has no comment saying why it is needed.
The hydrogen label is the string 'H' instead of the AtomLabel enum (also at line 848).
A block of commented-out code is left in place.
The popup lists many parent selectors to detect outside clicks; one class or data attribute on the elements would be sturdier.
The number 8 is a literal that the code already uses elsewhere; it should be one shared constant.
The change leaves this hook file unused; delete it.
The wizard listens for a window-level event, so with several Ketcher instances on a page every instance reacts.
ColorPicker handles popup state and positioning, settings persistence, the presets grid and the custom colors; split the grid and the custom colors into components.
The same default value is also the initial useState value; extract a constant.
Custom colors are a separate state kept in sync with settings; derive them from settings instead.
The effect depends on isOpen, so it writes settings each time the dropdown opens, even with no action; write them when an action is applied.
The dropdown open, close and positioning are written from scratch; the app already uses MUI primitives for this (ModeControl, ElementWithPopover).
A hex color with saturation below 100 jumps to saturation 100 as soon as the hue or lightness knob moves.
The color utilities use shorthand parameter and variable names.

entries.title: #8188 No error if data structure doesn't comply with data structure of sdf and CTFile formats specification
entries.head: d9cb55bdbb151df9ac46800036a305f58b0c2cdb

expected.summary: The same early-return guard is written twice in a row.
The change parses SDF on the client; parsing formats is the job of Indigo, the backend.
The error handling spread through the reducer should sit in one try-catch inside initializeMonomersLibraryFromKetcher.
A nested ternary operator.
